blocking_reason: The active third family was changed from MambaIR to MPRNet before confirmatory training. The exact MPRNet source and integration contract are frozen, but active-set source preflight and MPRNet forward/backward GPU smoke have not passed yet.

candidate_change_control.decision_timing: before any confirmatory full training and before any MPRNet result
candidate_change_control.reason: The verified Windows host lacks the CUDA extension build chain required by the official mamba_ssm and causal_conv1d dependencies. MPRNet has an official deblurring implementation without that custom CUDA-extension dependency.
candidate_change_control.prohibition: MambaIR must not be represented as an executed G11 comparison model.

primary_design.comparison: within-backbone paired base package versus MERIT full package
primary_design.capacity_policy: use one frozen native official configuration per family; disclose parameters/FLOPs and do not claim cross-family architectural superiority
primary_design.package_parameter_rule: within each backbone, base and MERIT arms must have identical trainable parameter count

input.channel_1: directional blur prompt map; zero for base, correct frozen oracle for MERIT
input.channel_2: noise prompt map; zero for base, correct frozen oracle for MERIT

adapter.policy: do not edit upstream source; wrap the unchanged official 3-channel model, select the manifest-frozen final output, retain channel 0 as the restored grayscale result, and apply the original MERIT [0,1] output clamp
adapter.mprnet_output_rule: select sequence index 0 only; the official Deblurring/test.py also evaluates restored[0], and Deblurring/MPRNet.py returns the stage-3 residual result at index 0
adapter.base_full_identity_rule: the exact same wrapper and official architecture instance definition is used in both package arms
adapter.safety_audit: forward_preclip exposes the unclipped selected channel only for out-of-range and saturation accounting; forward returns the clamped training/evaluation image

training.checkpoint_selection: fixed final step only; recovery checkpoints cannot be selected by outcome
training.mprnet_deep_supervision_policy: The official three-stage training losses are not added. For a controlled package comparison, the common frozen G11 objective is applied only to the official final restoration at sequence index 0 in both arms.
training.data_order: same frozen D0 parent-disjoint bank and seed-specific stream within every paired arm

nafnet.license: MIT for NAFNet code; bundled BasicSR Apache-2.0 notices retained
nafnet.selection_reason: official deblurring configuration and lower-capacity official width32 variant, frozen before C009 results

restormer.selection_reason: official motion-deblurring architecture configuration, frozen before C009 results

mprnet.selection_reason: official CVPR 2021 deblurring architecture and default constructor; selected as the pre-result replacement for the host-incompatible MambaIR candidate

paired_training_stream_freeze.authorization_effect: This closes the paired-stream subgate only and does not authorize full training.

mprnet_acquisition.overwrite_policy: reuse an existing target only when it is a clean Git worktree at the requested commit with the expected license and Deblurring directory; otherwise refuse

closure_requirements: Pass read-only source preflight v2 for NAFNet, Restormer, and MPRNet.
Pass MPRNet official-model base/full initial-state and trainable-parameter equality checks.
Pass MPRNet bfloat16 forward/backward smoke and record peak memory, step time, output range, and FLOP coverage status.
Rerun NAFNet and Restormer smoke under manifest v2 so all active candidates reference the same frozen active-set manifest.
Recompute G13 from v2 official-model timings before any full run.
